summary: Fix parse_expr(evaluate=False) by rewriting six comparison operators to SymPy relational constructors with evaluate=False and recursively preserving operands. Reject unsupported relational chains explicitly. Added regression coverage for numeric and symbolic operands, nested arithmetic, boolean combinations, unchanged evaluated parsing, and chains. Confirmed regression failed before the fix (28 passed, 1 failed); after fix parser tests: 29 passed; sympify tests: 46 passed, 5 skipped, 2 expected failures. Reviewed complete diff.
